name: Undercity
summary: Beneath Capital City, the Forsaken hold their underground stronghold, ruled by Sylvanas Windrunner. Its halls began as Scourge work and now shelter the free-willed undead.

sections.title: From Royal Crypts to Scourge Bastion
sections.body: Before the Third War, sewers, royal catacombs, and dungeons lay beneath Capital City. As Lordaeron fell, Prince Arthas Menethil ordered the Scourge to enlarge them into an underground seat of power. The Lich King summoned Arthas to Northrend before the work was finished.

sections.title: The Forsaken Capital
sections.body: During the civil war in the Plaguelands, Sylvanas Windrunner rallied undead who had escaped the Lich King's grip. She overthrew the dreadlords and drove out rival forces, and the Forsaken claimed the underground complex. They finished the maze of catacombs the Scourge had begun and fortified it beneath the silent ruins of their former kingdom. Now the Dark Lady rules her people from its poisoned halls.

faq.q: Was Undercity always here before the undead took over?
faq.answer: Yes. Ancient royal crypts, dungeons, and the city's sewers lay beneath Lordaeron's palace.

faq.q: Who actually built the modern Undercity?
faq.answer: Prince Arthas Menethil began expanding the old tunnels into a seat of power for the Scourge in Lordaeron. After Arthas was recalled to Northrend, Sylvanas Windrunner and her Forsaken seized the unfinished tunnels. They spent years excavating and fortifying them into the fortress city seen today.

faq.q: Why live underground instead of rebuilding the city above?
faq.answer: Capital City's surface ruins face attacks from the Scarlet Crusade, Scourge remnants, and the Alliance. The underground catacombs are defensible and hidden from view, and suit undead who need no daylight, warmth, or open air.

aliases: who is the leader of undercity
faq.answer: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, the Banshee Queen and leader of the Forsaken, rules the city from the royal quarters deep inside the complex.

angles.text: As an undead, you know the Undercity as the heart of Forsaken civilization. Its halls rise among the ruins and crypts of your former lives, sheltering you from the Scourge and the living alike.
As a member of the Horde, you can find its main military stronghold in the Eastern Kingdoms beneath the ground. Its dim passages, tainted by apothecaries, can unsettle visitors from Kalimdor.
